name: Kokoro TTS
tagline: Ultra-lightweight 82M-parameter open-weight text-to-speech model delivering fast, natural voices on CPU or modest GPUs.
real_test_summary: Tested generating multi-paragraph narration offline via Python and ONNX runtime on CPU. Produces clear, natural pacing at faster-than-realtime speeds with minimal memory overhead.
pros: 82M parameter footprint runs fast on CPU and low-end GPUs without latency
Apache-2.0 license permits unrestricted commercial voiceover and content creation
Multiple built-in voice presets with clean pronunciation and pacing
cons: Does not support zero-shot voice cloning from custom reference audio
Smaller language coverage compared to massive multilingual speech models
